mapper.update: UPDATE media_point_file SET upload_expires_at=#{expires},cleanup_after=TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR,24,#{expires}) WHERE upload_id=#{id} AND state='UPLOADING'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM media_point_file WHERE file_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM media_point_file WHERE upload_id=#{upload} AND file_index=#{index} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE media_point_file SET state='REGISTERED',created_at=#{now},unbound_expires_at=TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR,24,#{now}),cleanup_after=TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR,24,#{now}) WHERE file_id=#{id} AND state='UPLOADING' AND cleanup_after>#{now}
UPDATE media_point_file SET state='BOUND',application_id=#{application},unbound_expires_at=NULL WHERE file_id=#{id} AND owner_user_id=#{user} AND state='REGISTERED' AND unbound_expires_at>#{now}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM media_point_file WHERE state IN ('UPLOADING','REGISTERED','CLEANING') AND cleanup_after<=#{now} ORDER BY cleanup_after,file_id LIMIT 100
SELECT FROM media_point_file WHERE state='BOUND' AND source_deleted=FALSE AND upload_expires_at<=#{now} ORDER BY upload_expires_at,file_id LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE media_point_file SET state='CLEANING' WHERE file_id=#{id} AND state IN ('UPLOADING','REGISTERED','CLEANING') AND cleanup_after<=#{now} AND application_id IS NULL
